name: combine_two_sources
description: The answer needs both documents: one says which plan has 10 workers, the other what that plan costs.

input.question: How much does the Loomstack plan with 10 workers cost per month?

sources.plans.md:
# Plans

The Starter plan includes 2 workers. The Pro plan includes 10 workers.
sources.billing.md:
# Billing

The Pro plan costs 120 dollars per month. Starter is free.
